{"consolidated_memory":"DEDUPE STAGE DROPPED ROWS - THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS IN ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py

All three incidents share:
- Component: ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py (ingest side)
- Problem: dropped rows in the dedupe stage
- Repro method: run pipeline over overlapping day partitions
- Error signal: output count below input count
- All occurred in same corner of code, context carried over between fixes

---

INCIDENT 1: 2026-01-20 (Cache Invalidation Bug)
- Manifestation: dropped rows only for payloads above roughly 2 megabytes
- Root cause: cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #1630, branch fix/dropped-rows-1
- Measured outcome: throughput rose 19 percent, to 406 requests per second

INCIDENT 2: 2026-01-25 (Config Loader Bug)
- Manifestation: dropped rows only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #4385, branch fix/dropped-rows-2
- Measured outcome: p99 latency fell from 6.5 seconds to 81 milliseconds

INCIDENT 3: 2026-02-19 (Retry Loop Bug)
- Manifestation: dropped rows only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #6089, branch fix/dropped-rows-3
- Measured outcome: memory settled at 551 MB instead of climbing past 1 GB"}
